What the research says

A promising foundation, with trust as the clearest unmet need.

The findings come from 15 participants across tenant and host testing. Variant-level results are directional because each tenant MVP had four testers.

74.2Average SUSAcross 15 participants
80.6MVP2 SUSStrongest directional tenant result
60%Trust first9 of 15 ranked it #1
3.73/4RecommendationAverage participant rating

The product decision

Build the smallest credible path from discovery to verified contact.

Discover→ Filter→ Inspect→ Establish trust→ Understand place→ Contact

Scope and priority

Complete and credible before broad and clever.

Roomie's next iteration concentrates effort where testing showed it matters most: trustworthy people, trustworthy listings, and enough local context to make a housing decision.

P0Must validate

Trust infrastructure

  • Verified identities, hosts, and listings
  • Authentic, current property photos
  • Reviews and explainable Roomie Scores
  • Transparent price, fees, and availability
  • Reporting, moderation, and appeals
P1Should validate

Decision quality

  • MVP2 split map/list baseline
  • Occupancy, roommate, and lease context
  • Commute, transit, and daily needs
  • Price and relevance sorting
  • Listing-linked chat and viewings
P2After trust

Transaction readiness

  • Documents and contracts
  • Payment status and receipts
  • Optional regulated escrow pilot
  • Roommate matching and feeds
  • Moving and housing services

MVP direction

One integrated experience, informed by six prototypes.

Tenant MVP2 becomes the primary mobile discovery baseline, with MVP1's map synchronization and MVP3's curated rails retained as supporting patterns. Host concepts consolidate around listing quality, inquiries, and viewing operations before live payments.

Roadmap

Retire the highest-risk assumptions first.

  1. 01
    Specify

    Finalize trust definitions, listing schema, moderation workflow, and instrumentation.

    1-2 weeks
  2. 02
    Integrate

    Build one tenant and one host flow around the complete trust-to-viewing journey.

    2-4 weeks
  3. 03
    Validate

    Test comprehension, decision quality, accessibility, and contact confidence with 24+ participants.

    2 weeks
  4. 04
    Pilot

    Add persistent accounts, verification operations, moderation, analytics, and controlled supply.

    6-10 weeks
  5. 05
    Transact

    Only after gates: documents, payment tracking, and regulated partner assessment.

    After gates
